title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — November 15, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B6.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B8.0 (Peaked November 15, 2026 at 13:15 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 350 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

The Sun is about halfway through its roughly 10-billion-year main-sequence lifetime. Still plenty of time before retirement. 🌞🤍

Several active regions and sunspot groups are visible today, along with a broad darker coronal area; the coronagraph view appears routine.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 284 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
